blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Motorists will continue to enjoy diesel savings for a third consecutive week, while gasoline prices will likely rise again next week. In a Friday advisory, Jetti Petroleum president Leo Bellas said diesel prices may decrease by P1.80 to P2 per liter. READ: Tehran’s wartime billboards mock Trump, boast of victory Gasoline, meanwhile, may rise by P2 to P2.20 per liter.
